h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Jacksonville.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the vehicle
footer_blurb: Jimmy's Towing Service, LLC serving Jacksonville.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers car and light truck transport, night and out of hours calls. We work out of Jacksonville and the towns around it.
area_h2: Jacksonville and the area around it
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

reviews.author: Jaqueline Ruiz
reviews.text: You can definitely count on Jimmy’s Towing Service! My car battery exploded and not only were they polite and quick with the towing but they prevented me from spending money at a auto shop. They helped me get a new battery and installed it right there and then! They saved me an unnecessary trip and they were a blessing in such a stressful time. Wade and Brandon were of great help!

reviews.author: Jocelyn
reviews.text: Shout out to Branden who was so helpful! My shifter in my Yukon went out in the middle of Starbucks drive-thru and I was calling companies to get it towed to my dealership and luckily another company put me on hold for a long time and I ended up calling Jimmys and Branden answered. He was able to tell me what he thought was wrong over the phone and told me he could fix it when he arrived if that was the case. He was quick and fixed it right in the Starbucks drive-thru and got me back up and running. I will forever be grateful for him and his kindness! We still have kind people around, now this is a place I’ll always recommend.

reviews.author: Tina Philippe
reviews.text: I had such a positive experience with Brandon, the tow truck driver who helped me after my accident. He went above and beyond from start to finish, keeping me updated on his arrival time, showing up promptly, and treating me with genuine kindness and respect during a stressful situation. Brandon was professional, polite, and very helpful throughout the entire process. It’s rare to meet someone who truly cares about the people they’re helping, but he definitely does. I’m so grateful for his excellent service and would highly recommend him to anyone in need of towing assistance.

reviews.author: Jason B
reviews.text: From start to finish, the experience with Jimmy's Towing was fantastic. They quickly helped us get our broken-down car transported to the repair shop. What really stood out was their exceptional customer service and professionalism, they were incredibly helpful and treated us with the utmost respect. Thank you for making a stressful situation so much easier!

reviews.author: Amber Wayman
reviews.text: Eve did a fantastic job. Very fast, friendly and easy. Would recommend to anyone looking for a good towing service!

reviews.author: Tricia Wriston
reviews.text: Highly recommend and will definitely be my first call should I need towing again! My truck wouldn’t crank after doing some shopping. Called the office and spoke with two very nice ladies who gave me a quote and a timeframe. Adam arrived within the 35-45 min wait time window. Loaded it up and had it dropped off quickly. Very professional service! Thank you, Adam!

reviews.author: M. A. Gomez
reviews.text: Great telephone customer service. Mr Wade gave me a decent quote. He arrived in timely manner. Mr Wade is a very hard working man and was very informative. The vehicle was delivered and place in appropriate manner. Definitely would call the company again.

reviews.author: Liz Parasconda
reviews.text: 100% recommend. They were quick, efficient and polite. The gentleman called me immediately after I put a request in through my insurance and gave me an exact estimate of when he would arrive! All I had to do was sign and pass over my key. Quick and simple! I am very appreciative of how fast they came and will definitely use them again if I ever need another tow! Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Janet Hughes
reviews.text: We needed a car towed to get work done on it. It needed to go an hour away. I called and they were so helpful. We set a date and time. They called when they were on their way, and were a few minutes early. After they dropped it off they called to let us know. Extremely professional. I hope I don’t need them again but am glad to know I found a reputable towing service if I need them again.

reviews.author: Ashley Word
reviews.text: Branden was very polite, courteous, and careful with my car. He kept me updated on ETA so I knew when to expect him. I 100% recommend this towing company. I've never had to tow a car before, but he had my car loaded and to the shop within an hour and a half of the initial call on a Sunday evening. Prices were fair in my opinion for an emergency service.

reviews.author: Ethan Starzynski
reviews.text: Absolutely the best customer service and tow company, whenever we needed anything towed they are only a phone call away! Never left stranded with Jimmys!

reviews.author: RHONDA TOPPING
reviews.text: Jimmy's Towing is by far the best service we could have asked for in our time of need on the side of the road with a blow out. Thank you Whitney for answering our call and helping with locating us. Our tow truck driver Wade was the best. He not only helped with changing our tire he took us to a tire shop so we could get another tire. Thank you all for going above and beyond and know we appreciate yall!!! The Topping's

reviews.author: stephanie jackson
reviews.text: Woow I am so impressed with this tow company! I called to have my Suv towed to a shop. He went above and beyond for me! I was so grateful. I have never had a towing service give me the that exceptional experience. I can’t thank Brandon enough for all his work and time.! I’m telling everyone call them for your towing!! You want regret it!!

reviews.author: Brooke Gaddy
reviews.text: If you need a row CALL THEM! I didn’t catch the guys name but he was awesome, even helped push the car into the driveway AFTER towing it. Couldn’t have asked for a better towing experience!

reviews.author: Nick Treadwell
reviews.text: Unfortunately for me I've had a couple interactions with Jimmy's. Both were fantastic experiences. The staff are professional and very accommodating to what is likely a poor situation when dealing with roadside assistance. Drivers are top notch.

reviews.author: Rhonda Shields
reviews.text: We were broke down on side of Hwy 24 in Richlands. We needed a Towing Co to tow our truck back to Jacksonville. We called Jimmy’s & I talked to Brandon. Right before he got to us a Thunderstorm came! I felt so bad for him! He was Fast & Efficient loading truck. Very Good Communication & Super Nice!! Def Recommend!!

reviews.author: Blake Everard
reviews.text: Called for a short notice tow to Swansboro from Camp Lejeune. They got it done in under an hour and a half. Quick easy process and great price. I can't remember what the gentleman's name was who answered the phone but Adam took care of the tow and was super polite and professional throughout the duration of what usually is a frustrating process. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Neal Chamberlain
reviews.text: Five star service, first class treatment. Professionalism at its finest, highly recommend. When you are in need of red carpet treatment with a tow, please call Jimmy’s towing. They will take excellent care of you. Jose was fantastic! Tell him that Ronnie says Hi.

reviews.author: Shelbi Windle
reviews.text: I was stranded at work with a dead battery and knew exactly who to call. Had help and a running car within 20 minutes! Staff is so great and always speedy. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Briana Baker
reviews.text: I called Jimmy’s towing to get my car towed to the dealership because everything I read online and calling the Kia dealership themselves I was told I was going to have to get my whole key fob replaced and reprogrammed for $400 not including the tow. When he came out, he asked me what was going on and suggested that we try and jump start the battery and see if that works and it did. So instead of getting a tow, he told me to follow him to auto zone and helped me get set up with a new battery that works perfectly fine and spent less than half of what I was going to have to before. GREAT SERVICE and would definitely use them again if I ever need a tow!!

reviews.author: brandon duncan
reviews.text: These guys are the best in town! Fair prices, great service, always show up on time. I will not use anyone else.

reviews.author: Miles Tanner (enemystalker77)
reviews.text: After getting into an accident and state farm playing games with my time and money, I decided to pay for towing. They managed to get my car towed in roughly 2.5 hours with no notice. Definitely worth the money!

reviews.author: Katelyn Garcia
reviews.text: They got to me faster than I had anticipated and they had stated. When stranded quick service is always a huge plus in my book, all staff very professional and knowledgeable in what was going on. All of my questions answered, would definitely call them again

reviews.author: WyattCAM17
reviews.text: While I didn’t get the towing service, on the phone Wade was top notch. He recommended something better for my situation, and extremely helpful.

reviews.author: Jared Fendrick
reviews.text: Great customer service! They have base access and informed me on what I needed to do to expedite their time at the gate. Highly recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Joe Col
reviews.text: My truck was stranded, would not start, spoke to a gentleman said he would be an hour and a half, then got a call back an hour and 20 minutes later, stating that he will not be there by a female that acted like she did not care how cold it was outside and that I was with my love ones, gave me a bunch of phone numbers that tried to rip me off at the end of the day. Had to leave my car at a parking lot sleep at a hotel And had it towed in the morning, don’t run a company. If you have an attitude like you don’t care, because at the end of the day, it’s your livelihood. I’m a working man with a family. If she would’ve apologized, it would’ve been sufficient

reviews.author: Julie Landrigan
reviews.text: I was stranded and the lady gave me a time and place, then a hour and half later called me and said her own truck broke down, gave me some a number of her “friend” who quoted me double and said they don’t know her. She ignored my calls. She is completely unprofessional and should not be running anything but a ballon shop because she is an airhead! Thank god for “primary towing” who actually came to the rescue!

reviews.author: thomas foresman
reviews.text: Excellent tow and recovery company. Ray, is the Epitome of customer relations. Thank you, Ray. Very professional, cordial and knowledgeable, efficient.

reviews.author: Paul Andryshak
reviews.text: Very professional and quick. They were able to have a truck at my house within 30 mins. Ray was great.

reviews.author: Jon Shinskie
reviews.text: Very friendly folks, they were able to get my car towed to the shop super quick. Very polite and great prices. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Stephanie Seiter
reviews.text: Jimmy's towed our Camry after my husband totaled it. We had a great experience with them! They were very friendly and had no issues helping us.

reviews.author: Jeff Shipman
reviews.text: Best ***** service around. Came out to pick up my truck late at night when no one else would answer my call.... and drove an hour and a half to pamlico county to drop it off. Super friendly driver. Will be my non local, first choice towing service from now on!!!

reviews.author: Scott Capps
reviews.text: Brandon come out quick to help me get my lawnmower out of a ditch! He did an amazing job and made sure my mower wasn’t hurt. If you need a tow service this is the one to call!

reviews.author: Thomas Longar
reviews.text: Branden was fantastic! Kept us updated with where he was and how and where the van was once he was done. While I hope not to need his service any time soon, I would be 100% comfortable knowing he was on the job.

reviews.author: Superior Carpet Cleaning
reviews.text: Excellent company, have been using them for years and just had them tow me all the way from Wilmington last minute. Amazing staff, best in the business!

reviews.author: Leo Douglas
reviews.text: Professional service and they are 24 hrs. Handled the tow that I requested in a timely manner and without a problem. Come to these guys first!!! They'll take care of you

reviews.author: KELLOGG
reviews.text: I called this company because I got tired of waiting for AAA for 2 hours The lady on the phone was very nice said he'd be there in about 10 minutes he showed up in 10 minutes hooked it up very fast got me home in 10 minutes Thanks a lot Wade you're great man!

reviews.author: Celeste Chance
reviews.text: Polite courteous attention to detail for my vehicle, which I greatly appreciated and was able to allow me to ride with them to the auto. Body shop can't say anything other than thank you.

reviews.author: Ashley Booth
reviews.text: 10/10 I had my truck towed from Jacksonville to Havelock and it was very reasonable. The driver was very nice and helpful I would absolutely use them again if I need to

reviews.author: Allison Rook
reviews.text: Super speedy and professional service from the driver Wade. Can't emphasize enough how much I appreciate it!

reviews.author: Deborah High
reviews.text: After calling 4 other companies,Jimmy's was honestly the cheapest,fastest,and called us right back to confirm and give a time for eta,even when there was a problem finding us on highway,he never gave up or just let us stay abandoned, broken down with 2small kids in car,on the highway,.I would definitely use their services again and highly recommend them to anyone needing someone quick,honest, reliable and in an emergency.Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Mariah Jarman
reviews.text: Called another place and they wouldn’t come out in the rain to tow my cousins car. Called him and he was at my cousins car quick and was so polite!

reviews.author: peggy roberts
reviews.text: I was surprised how quickly they responded. Once they arrived, my flat was changed in about 5 minutes. The service was wonderful!!

reviews.author: Anthony B
reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday and they were in ~30min. The staff are very friendly. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Deshawn Owens
reviews.text: Would definitely give 10 stars if i could. The process was easy and fast. Customer service was a 10/10.

reviews.author: H Chesher
reviews.text: Excellent towing service with friendly staff and excellent response rate! Thankful for their assistance in getting out of a tight situation.
